metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: FIMZIO crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C163 H199 Gd28 N25 O144 8+,27(H2 O1),8(Br1 1-). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd3 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd4 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd5 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd6 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd7 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd8 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd9 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd10 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd11 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd12 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd13 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd14 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd15 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd16 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd17 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd18 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd19 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd20 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd21 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd22 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd23 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd24 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd25 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd26 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd27 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd28 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 60 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.575-4.121 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 86.54-119.56°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C163H253Gd28N25O171Br8.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
